name: transition-gravity-drop
title: Gravity Drop
description: Cảnh cũ nằm trên cùng, nghiêng và rơi khỏi khung như bị trọng lực kéo, lộ cảnh mới đứng yên bên dưới.

moworks.author: moworks

options.drop: fall, × the frame height (1.2; the small demo 1.3)
options.rotate: degrees about the top centre (10; demo 20)
options.from: the outgoing scene, which falls; the incoming waits still underneath

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Outgoing scene stays on top and falls: y 0 -> +120 % of frame height and rotation 0 -> 10 deg about its top centre, 700 ms easeInQuad; the incoming scene sits still underneath from the start. Demo: +130 %, 20 deg, ease-in cubic. HF showcase-other ships a Gravity Drop. Params: duration (0.7 s) · drop (120 %) · rotate (10°).
